blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent work shows that depth recurrence can be retrofitted into pretrained language models. In this work, we adapt this paradigm for visual understanding, using depth recurrence to reduce the parameter footprint of a pretrained vision-language model (VLM). To this end, we prune layers from the language backbone of the VLM and loop over a subset of the remaining layers. At each step of the loop, a linear adapter merges the block's output with the token representations from the preceding layers and projects the fused representation back into the block. As the pruning impacts the original model performance, we propose a three-stage recovery training: first, we leverage a language-only pretraining to recover the performance of the language backbone, followed by an alignment of the vision-language projector, and a full fine-tuning of the model via visual instruction tuning. In the first and the last stage, we distill the outputs of the pretrained non-recurrent model into the recurrent model, which further improves the recovery. We evaluate the proposed approach on the TinyLLaVA-1.4B backbone without introducing any new vision-language data during retrofitting. Our experiments demonstrate that the retrofitted recurrent model outperforms the unpruned baseline trained with the same recovery data while storing 23.3% fewer language parameters. We further show that the proposed retrofitting recurrence outperforms the setup of converting a recurrent LM into a VLM on the same data. Additionally, our ablations show how design choices, such as the adapter between recurrences and a larger recurrent block, lead to the improved performance of our approach. Finally, we find that our proposed model gains on reasoning-oriented benchmarks, whereas its performance on basic visual understanding benchmarks remains on par with the baseline.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作表明,深度再现可以被改造为被预先训练的语言模型. 在这部作品中,我们为视觉理解改造了这个范式,利用深度重现来减少被预先训练的视觉语言模型(VLM)的参数足迹. 为此,我们从 VLM 的语言主干线上 分层循环到其余的分层上。 在循环的每一步,一个线性适配器会将块的输出与前几层的符号表示相合并,并预测被熔接的表示返回块. 随着穿梭会影响原型的性能,我们提议进行三阶段恢复训练:一是利用只用语言的预训来恢复语言主干线的性能,再由视觉语言投影仪对接,再通过视觉教学调音对模型进行全面微调. 在第一阶段和最后阶段,我们把经过预先训练的非经常模式的产出提炼成经常模式,这进一步改善了恢复。 我们评价关于TinyLLAVA-1.4B主干线的拟议办法,在改造过程中不引入任何新的视觉语言数据。 我们的实验表明,经过改造的经常性模型在使用同样的恢复数据培训的未刷入基线的基础上,超过了业绩,同时储存了23.3%的语言参数。 我们进一步表明,拟议中的再生改造超过了在同一数据上将经常性LM转换为VLM的设置. 此外,我们的模拟显示,设计选择,例如复发和较大的再生区块之间的适应器,如何导致我们方法的绩效得到改进。 最后,我们发现,我们提议的模型在以推理为导向的基准方面有所进展,而它在基本视觉理解基准方面的表现仍然与基线相同。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Existing approaches for test-time compute scaling in vision-language models comprise chain-of-thought traces, latent reasoning tokens, searching over candidate answers, and test-time reinforcement learning ( Zhang et al., 2024b ; Qin et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Singh et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2026 ) . These methods usually come with higher inference costs as each generated token requires a full forward pass and expands the context window.
To address this limitation, depth recurrence ( Geiping et al., 2025 ; McLeish et al., 2025 ) has been explored as an alternative for test-time scaling in language models. Depth recurrence allocates test-time compute to iterating a block of layers rather than generating tokens, thereby maintaining smaller context sizes and a smaller memory overhead independent of reasoning length.
blocks.zh:
现有测试时间计算在视觉语言模型中的缩放方法包括思维链痕、潜在推理符号、搜索候选答案以及测试时间强化学习(Zhang等人,2024b;秦等人,2025年;徐等人,2025年;辛格等人,2025年;Wan等人,2026年)。 这些方法通常具有较高的推论成本,因为每个生成的符号都需要一个完整的前传并扩展上下文窗口.
为了解决这一局限性,已探讨将深度重现(Geiping等人,2025年;McLeish等人,2025年)作为语文模型测试时间缩放的替代办法。 深度重现分配测试-时间计算来重现一个块的层而不是生成符号,从而保持了较小的上下文大小和独立于推理长度的较小内存管理.

blocks.en: But depth recurrence has also gained traction in visual understanding. Here, recurrent VLM architectures are built in two ways: first, either by starting from a recurrent language model and post-hoc adding a vision backbone, or, second, by looping an existing VLM without removing any of its layers. The first approach is i.a. adopted by HIVE ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , which extends a recurrent language model pretrained from scratch by a vision backbone. Examples for the second approach are, RecursiveVLM ( Xu et al., 2026 ) and ReLoop-UME ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , which loop layers in pretrained VLMs without pruning, with a near-constant number of parameters.
blocks.zh: 但深度重现也获得了视觉理解的牵引力. 在这里,经常性的VLM架构是用两种方式构建的:第一,要么从经常性语言模型开始,然后在hoc后添加视觉主干线;第二,在不移除任何层的情况下,循环现有的VLM. 第一种方法是HIVE(Zhang等人,2026年)采用的方法,将反复出现的语言模型从头到尾通过视觉主干来延伸. 第二种方法的例子有RecursiveVLM(Xu等人,2026年)和ReLoop-UME(Wang等人,2026年),这些方法在预先训练的VLM中循环层,没有穿透,参数数几乎保持不变.

blocks.en:
In contrast to these two regimes, we pursue a third option of retrofitting a pretrained VLM with recurrence, following a prune-then-loop strategy. Namely, we remove some intermediate blocks of the language backbone of the VLM and loop over a subset of the remaining layers. This strategy is supported by two complementary research findings: first, one set of recent works shows that a fraction of a VLM’s layers can be removed at a limited cost in accuracy ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Madinei et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) ,
and, second, another set of works shows that the layers of a pretrained model can be skipped or repeated at inference ( Li et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . We thus hypothesize that iteratively executing the subset of layers of a pruned
VLM can recover the capacity lost due to pruning. We test this hypothesis by retrofitting , i.e., by converting a pretrained non-recurrent VLM into
a recurrent one while reusing its existing weights rather than pretraining a
recurrent model from scratch.
We refer to the resulting model as retrofitted recurrent VLM (RR-VLM).
We prune a block of intermediate layers from the language backbone of a pretrained VLM and designate a contiguous subset of the remaining layers as a recurrent block ( McLeish et al., 2025 ) . To
feed the block’s output back into its input for successive iterations, we
concatenate the output with the tokens
from the layers preceding the recurrent block and train a linear layer to
compress this concatenated representation to its original dimensionality ( McLeish et al., 2025 ) .
An overview of the process is given in Figure 1 .
This surgery, however, degrades the pretrained language backbone, and although
text-only training repairs it, the repair leaves the language model misaligned
with the original projector. We resolve this with a three-stage training curriculum: first, we apply a text-only training to repair the backbone, second, we apply a projector-only training to restore the
image-text alignment, and third, we fine-tune the entire model on visual
instruction data. In the text-only and the instruction-tuning stage, we add a knowledge distillation (KD) term, with the pretrained model as teacher, to avoid the language backbone from drifting too far from the original representation that the projector was aligned with.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
We evaluate the proposed method on the TinyLLaVA-1.4B backbone ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , training it on 60B tokens of text as well as 493k image–caption
pairs and 660k instruction tuning samples from the base model’s training data, without introducing any new vision-language data. We compare the resulting model against the pretrained TinyLLaVA-1.4B model and four baselines trained on the same data: (1) the unpruned model subjected to the identical recovery training, (2) the unpruned model without the text-only stage, (3) the pruned model without recurrence, and (4) a recurrent language model that has been extended to a VLM.
Our experiments show that our proposed retrofitted recurrent model outperforms the unpruned baseline while having 23.3 % 23.3\% fewer language-model parameters and show that this gain is due to the recurrence rather than the recovery training. The gain concentrates on reasoning-oriented benchmarks, whereas performance on basic visual understanding benchmarks remains on par with the baseline. Compared to a recurrent language model extended to a VLM, our retrofitted model achieves a higher average accuracy.
We further ablate each component of the retrofit: the training stages, the layer allocation, the knowledge distillation term, KV-cache sharing at inference and the adapter. We find that the text-only stage S 0 S_{0} is necessary for the recovery, as removing it costs 3.68 3.68 pp, primarily on the reasoning-oriented benchmarks.
Specifically, we evaluate our linear adapter against three variants: a gated adapter, the Parcae adapter ( Prairie et al., 2026 ) , which multiplies the recurrent state with a learned per-channel factor within ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) so that the hidden state remains bounded across recurrences, and no adapter at all.
Our ablations show that, among the adapter variants, the linear adapter yields the best performance, whereas the gated adapter and the Parcae adapter score below the variant without an adapter.
Furthermore, we show that at equal compute, a larger recurrent block results in better performance.
We also show that distillation from the pretrained model improves recovery training and increases the performance of the retrofitted recurrent model. Finally, we find that a model trained at a fixed depth only works at the depth it was trained at, whereas a model trained with sampled recurrence works at other depths, but its performance does not improve beyond the trained depth.
We also find that sharing the KV cache across recurrences during inference costs accuracy, which contrasts with the results reported for a model pretrained with recurrence ( Geiping et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们评价TinyLLAVA-1.4B主干线上的拟议方法(周等人,2024年),对它进行60B字节以及493k图像封装的培训。
配对和660k指示调试来自基准模型培训数据的样本,而不引入任何新的视觉语言数据。 我们比较了所形成的模型与预先训练的TinyLLAVA-1.4B模型和根据相同数据训练的4个基线:(1) 接受相同恢复训练的未穿插模型,(2) 没有文本唯一阶段的未穿插模型,(3) 无重复的已穿插模型,(4) 已被扩展为VLM的经常性语言模型.
我们的实验表明,我们提议的改装的经常性模型超越了未铺设的基线,同时减少了23.3%的语文模型参数,并表明这一增益是由于重现而不是恢复培训。 收益集中于以推理为导向的基准,而基本视觉理解基准的绩效与基线相同。 与推广到VLM的经常性语言模型相比,我们的改造模型实现了更高的平均精度.
我们进一步降低改装的每个部分:培训阶段、层层分配、知识蒸馏术语、推论中的KV-cache共享和适配器。 我们认为,只有文本阶段S 0 S_{0}对于恢复是必要的,因为删除它需要3.68 3.68 pp, 主要是以推理为导向的基准。
具体地说,我们对照三个变体来评价我们的线性适配器:一个有门的适配器,Parcae适配器(Prairie et al., 2026),它用在(0, 1) (0, 1) 内的每个通道的学习系数乘以经常状态,这样隐藏状态仍然被束缚在复发之间,完全没有适配器.
我们的缩写显示,在适配器的变体中,线性适配器产生最佳性能,而门性适配器和帕尔凯适配器则在变体以下没有适配器.
此外,我们显示,在同样的计算中,一个较大的经常区块会提高业绩。
我们还表明,从预先训练过的模型中蒸馏可以改善恢复培训,提高改造后的经常性模型的性能. 最后,我们发现在固定深度训练的模型只在它所训练的深度工作,而在其他深度训练的具有抽样重复的模型则工作,但其性能并没有超过训练的深度改进。
我们还发现,在推论费用准确性期间,通过重复分享KV缓存,这与所报告预加训练的模型结果形成对比(Geiping等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
We summarize our contributions as follows: (1) We introduce the first prune-then-loop retrofit of a pretrained VLM evaluated on VQA, supported by a three-stage curriculum that repairs the pruned language backbone and restores projector alignment using the base model’s vision-language training data.
(2) We demonstrate that retrofitting recurrence directly into a pretrained VLM outperforms the alternative of adding a vision encoder to a pretrained recurrent language model.
(3) We perform an extensive evaluation of the retrofitted recurrent VLM and quantify the impact of each design decision.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献总结如下: (1) 我们推出对在VQA上评价的经过预先训练的VLM进行第一次prune-when-loop改装,辅以一个三阶段课程,利用基准模型的视觉语言培训数据,修复所铺设的语言主干线,恢复投影仪对齐.
(2)我们证明,将重现直接改装成经过预先训练的VLM,比在经过预先训练的经常性语言模型中添加视觉编码器的替代办法要好。
(3)我们对经过改造的经常性VLM进行广泛评价,量化每个设计决定的影响.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Depth recurrence reuses a block of layers multiple times, increasing the effective depth of the model without adding any additional parameters ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ) . Previous attempts at creating recurrent LMs include Huginn ( Geiping et al., 2025 ) and Ouro ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Huginn splits the model into three components: a prelude that embeds the input into a latent state, a recurrent block that iterates on that state, and a coda that decodes the final state into output logits. Ouro iterates the entire set of layers, and Loopie ( Gao et al., 2026 ) applies each layer recurrently instead of performing block-level looping. In all three cases, the model is trained from scratch without any pre-initialization by existing models. Two findings inform our design: a looped block benefits from a stable learned connector between successive passes ( Prairie et al., 2026 ) , and an iterated layer contributes only a fraction of the capacity of a stored one ( Schwethelm et al., 2026 ) , thus bounding what recurrence can recover from pruning. As an alternative to full-corpus pretraining, recurrence can instead be achieved by retrofitting a pretrained model. Within this regime, there exist two lines of work: (1) looping a middle block of the stack without pruning, for latent reasoning ( Koishekenov et al., 2025 ) , and (2) looping after reducing the depth, either by keeping a block of the surviving layers ( Bae et al., 2025 ; McLeish et al., 2025 ) or by merging neighbouring layers into a few blocks that are then looped ( Kwon & Park, 2026 ) . We adopt the latter approach, retrofitting recurrence after structural pruning. Specifically, we take inspiration from McLeish et al. (2025) , who drop layers 4 to 9 of TinyLlama-1.1B to obtain a 4 / 8 / 4 4/8/4 layer allocation looped through a linear adapter.
blocks.zh: 深度重现多次重用一层层块,增加了模型的有效深度,没有增加任何附加参数(Dehghani等人,2019年). 以往多次试图创建LMS的尝试包括Huginn(Geiping等人,2025年)和Ouo(Zhu等人,2025年)。 Huginn将模型分为三个部分:一个将输入嵌入到潜伏状态的序曲,一个重复出现的块在该状态上,以及一个将最终状态解码为输出日志的coda. Ouro 重排整个层层,而Loopie(Gao et al., 2026)则经常应用每层,而不是进行块级循环. 在所有三种情况下,该模型都是从零开始训练的,没有经过现有模型的任何初始化。 两项结论为我们的设计提供了依据:一个循环的区块收益来自连续通道之间稳定的学习连接器(Prairie等人,2026年),一个迭代层只贡献了存储层容量的一小部分(Schwethelm等人,2026年),从而限定了复发可以从挤压中恢复的内容. 作为全军预训的替代品,可以通过改装预训型号来实现复发. 在这一体制内,存在两条工作线:(1) 为潜在推理环绕堆积物的中间块(Koishekenov等人,2025年),以及(2) 在缩小深度后环绕,要么通过保留存活层块(Bae等人,2025年;McLeish等人,2025年),要么通过将邻近层块合并成几个块,然后循环(Kwon & Park,2026年)。 我们采用后一种方法,在结构修补后进行再现。 具体来说,我们从McLeish等人(2025年)那里获得灵感,他们将TinyLlama-1.1B的4至9层降下,通过线性适配器循环获得4 / 8 / 4 4/8/4层分配.

blocks.en:
Current works either loop layers of a pretrained VLM without pruning, with a near-constant number of parameters ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , or build one on a natively recurrent language backbone ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
HIVE ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) builds a VLM on the pretrained recurrent language model Huginn-3.5B ( Geiping et al., 2025 ) by attaching an InternViT-300M vision encoder and training the combined model on 6.5M training samples in three stages.
As such HIVE is based on a significantly larger model and trained on five times more training samples than the proposed model, preventing a direct comparison to those checkpoints.
We therefore take inspiration from the pipeline in HIVE to replicate this setting as a baseline to compare to rather than comparing against their model.
Beyond standard vision-language tasks, depth recurrence has been explored for robotic action policies, either in the action head of an intact VLM ( Tur et al., 2026 ) or by pruning a VLM and looping a small block ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . However, these methods operate in a fundamentally different domain, and the pruned variant of Shen et al. (2026) lacks a prune-only baseline. Our setting departs from those existing approaches by following a prune-then-loop pattern, removing layers before the loop is installed. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first prune-then-loop retrofit of a pretrained VLM evaluated on VQA.
blocks.zh:
当前作品有的是在未磨损的情况下预修的VLM的循环层,其参数近乎恒定(徐等人,2026年;王等人,2026年),有的则在本土反复出现的语言骨干上建一个(张等人,2026年).
HIVE(Zhang等人,2026年)在Huginn-3.5B(Geiping等人,2025年)的预训经常性语言模型上建立了VLM,为此附上了InternViT-300M视觉编码器,并在6.5M培训样本上对综合模型进行了三个阶段的培训.
因此,艾滋病毒/艾滋病教育是以一个大得多的模型为基础的,其培训样本是拟议模型的五倍,无法直接与这些检查站进行比较。
因此,我们从艾滋病毒/艾滋病教育的管道中汲取灵感,将这一设定作为基准来与模型进行比较而不是比较。
除了标准的视觉语言任务之外,还探索了机器人行动政策的深度重现,无论是在完整VLM(Tur等人,2026年)的动作头部,还是通过播放VLM和循环小块(Shen等人,2026年). 然而,这些方法在根本不同的领域运作,而沈等人(2026年)的普鲁士变体缺乏一个纯prune的基线. 我们的设置与这些现有方法不同,它遵循了一个时空模式,在安装环路之前去除层。 据我们所知 这部作品是第一次 在VQA上经过训练的 VLM 改装

blocks.en: 3 Method: Prune-Then-Loop Retrofitting
blocks.zh: 3 方法:普鲁纳-然后-洛普 改造

blocks.en: We study the problem of converting a pretrained non-recurrent vision-language model into a depth-recurrent architecture. In this section, we formalize the prune-then-loop retrofit, explaining the proposed model surgery, the training curriculum used to recover performance, and the adapter mechanism.
blocks.zh: 我们研究将预先训练的非经常性视觉语言模型转变为深度经常性建筑的问题。 在这一节中,我们正式确定了prune-when-loop改装,解释了拟议的模型手术,用于恢复性能的培训课程,以及适配器机制.

text sequence x x as F ( I , x ) = L ( u ) , L = ℓ m ∘ ⋯ ∘ ℓ 1 , u = [ π ( V ( I ) ) ; E ( x ) ] , F(I,x)\;=\;L(u),\qquad L=\ell_{m}\circ\cdots\circ\ell_{1},\qquad u=[\,\pi(V(I));\,E(x)\,], (1) where V V denotes the vision encoder, π \pi the projector, E E the text token embedder, and L L the language model composed of layers operating on representations of dimension H H .
Our prune-then-loop mechanism modifies only the layers ℓ 1 , … , ℓ m \ell_{1},\dots,\ell_{m} of the language model L L .
We partition the m m layers into four consecutive groups of sizes p + d + b + c = m p+d+b+c=m and delete the d d layers. blocks.en: 3.2 Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训战略

blocks.en:
The retrofitted model of Sec. 3.1 requires training for two reasons. First, the pruning removes the layers between the prelude and the recurrent block, leading to a misalignment between the representations produced by the prelude and those expected by the recurrent block. Additionally, the remaining layers have to be adapted to the modified architecture.
Second, the recurrence introduces an adapter A A that fuses the output of the prelude with the output of the recurrent block using a newly initialized linear layer that needs to be trained as well.
blocks.zh:
Sec. 3.1的改装型号需要训练,原因有二. 首先,普鲁姆清除了序曲和重复区块之间的层层,导致序曲和重复区块所预期的表示错位. 此外,其余各层必须适应修改后的建筑.
其次,复发引入了适配器A,将前奏的输出与复发区块的输出连接在一起,使用新初始化的线性层,也需要训练.

blocks.en: We propose a three-stage curriculum that restores the VLM and trains the adapter: First, in stage S 0 S_{0} we focus on repairing by training only the pruned language backbone on text-only data, freezing all other components. Second, as the retrained text backbone can now slightly deviate from the original one, we retrain the vision-language projector in stage S 1 S_{1} to restore image-text alignment, and finally optimize the entire model via end-to-end training with visual instruction data in stage S 2 S_{2} , interleaving image-text and text-only training data.

blocks.en: Retraining the modified language backbone inevitably shifts its internal representations away from those of the pretrained model. We therefore seek to adapt the language backbone to the new architecture while preserving its original representations as far as possible. blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate the models on the following nine benchmarks: GQA ( Hudson & Manning, 2019 ) , POPE ( Li et al., 2023b ) , TextVQA (TVQA) ( Singh et al., 2019 ) , and ScienceQA-IMG (SQA) ( Lu et al., 2022 ) , MMBench (MMB) ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , RealWorldQA (RWQA) ( xAI, 2024 ) , SEED-Bench (SEED) ( Li et al., 2023a ) , AI2D ( Kembhavi et al., 2016 ) , and the 2D split of CV-Bench (CV2D) ( Tong et al., 2024 ) .
We use the VLMEvalKit ( Duan et al., 2024 ) library for all model evaluations.
We define the Avg metric as the arithmetic mean of the nine VQA benchmarks.
We set a fixed eval seed to make evaluation deterministic.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the proposed recurrence retrofitting approach against five baselines and report the results in Table 1 . The first baseline is the pretrained TinyLLaVA-1.4B checkpoint without any modifications. The second and third baselines fine-tune this model without pruning, either with the image-text stages S 1 S_{1} and S 2 S_{2} only or with all three stages S 0 S_{0} , S 1 S_{1} and S 2 S_{2} of our training strategy. The fourth baseline applies all three stages to the pruned model without recurrence, which corresponds to the single-pass model F 1 F^{1} of Sec. 3.1 . The baselines with the text-only stage apply the distillation term of Eq. 4 in S 0 S_{0} , and the unpruned Baseline+ ( S 0 , S 1 , S 2 ) (S_{0},S_{1},S_{2}) also applies it in S 2 S_{2} , so that it is trained with the full strategy of our model. We include those retrained versions to allow a direct comparison between the retrofitted recurrent model and the same non-recurrent backbones trained on the same data.

We see that the training improves the baseline models by around 2.4 2.4 to 2.9 2.9 pp, while the performance of the pruned model is slightly below that of the base model.
The performance of the converted recurrent VLM is in the same range as the retrained baselines.

Analyzing the performance per dataset, we see that more basic visual understanding datasets, such as GQA, POPE, TVQA and SQA, do not profit as much from the recurrent architecture, and that the RR-VLM performs on par with the baseline model. We thus find that retrofitting a pretrained VLM results in better performance than introducing a vision encoder into a recurrent language model to create a recurrent VLM.

We determine the effect of the text-only stage S 0 S_{0} and the vision-language alignment stage S 1 S_{1} on the resulting recurrent VLM in Table 2 . We find that S 0 S_{0} is crucial to the recovery training, as removing it reduces the performance of the resulting model by 3.68 3.68 pp on average. Removing S 0 S_{0} primarily affects the reasoning-oriented datasets, with 7.3 7.3 pp lost on CV2D, 6.8 6.8 pp on MMB and 4.6 4.6 pp on AI2D. We attribute this to the fact that without the repair of the pruned language backbone in S 0 S_{0} , the stages S 1 S_{1} and S 2 S_{2} have to repair the language backbone and align the projector at the same time.
We further find that removing S 1 S_{1} costs 1.28 1.28 pp, again primarily on the reasoning-oriented datasets. We attribute this to the fact that S 1 S_{1} performs the vision-language alignment, and without it the stage S 2 S_{2} has to perform both the alignment and the instruction tuning.
In summary, both S 0 S_{0} and S 1 S_{1} contribute to the performance, with S 0 S_{0} having the larger impact, which shows that the text-only recovery is necessary for retrofitting recurrence into a pruned VLM.

blocks.en:
We further evaluate the effect of the number of recurrences during training in Table 5 . To this end, we compare a model trained with a fixed number of recurrences r = 6 r{=}6 against a model trained with a variable number of recurrences, sampled per training step with mean 6 6 (Sec. 3.1 ). Both models are evaluated at test-time depths from r = 2 r{=}2 to r = 16 r{=}16 .
We find that the model trained with a fixed recurrence only works at the depth it was trained for, degrades at the neighbouring depths and collapses beyond r = 8 r{=}8 or below r = 5 r{=}5 . Its GQA accuracy drops from 59.7 59.7 at r = 6 r{=}6 to 43.1 43.1 at r = 5 r{=}5 and 50.9 50.9 at r = 8 r{=}8 , and the output degenerates at all other depths. In contrast, the model trained with a sampled recurrence regime also works at depths other than the one it was trained for, staying within 2 2 pp of its best value from r = 2 r{=}2 to r = 16 r{=}16 . This can be attributed to the fact that the sampled regime exposes the model to a different number of recurrences in every training step, so that its readout is trained for every depth in that range. However, we find that its performance saturates and does not improve beyond the trained depth. Consequently, we do not observe test-time scaling. The fixed and sampled recurrence models perform on par at the trained depth, with 55.75 55.75 against 55.83 55.83 on Avg. We therefore find that a fixed recurrence model is the less expensive approach to train a recurrent VLM, but it comes at the price of test-time stability to varying recurrences. Appendix A.5 evaluates early exit for the sampled model.

blocks.en:
Finally, we evaluate the effect of sharing the KV cache across recurrences at inference in Table 6 . To this end, we apply the inference-time sharing of Sec. 3.1 to our trained model and reduce the number of cache copies n n from one per recurrence, which is our setting, down to a single copy. Since every pass through the recurrent block keeps its own keys and values, our model holds 2.55 × \times the KV cache of the base model, in line with the 56 against 22 traversed layers per token, while it stores 18.1% fewer weights and outperforms it (Table 1 ).
We see that the cost grows as the budget n n shrinks. With n = 3 n{=}3 the cache shrinks to 1.45 × \times that of the base model at a cost of 0.75 0.75 pp, and with n = 1 n{=}1 it shrinks to 0.727 × \times , below the base model itself, at a cost of 5.43 5.43 pp. This can be attributed to the fact that the keys and values of a recurrence step are computed from the state of that step, so a recurrence step that reads the cache of another step attends to representations that do not match its own input. Training the model with the sharing active does not close this gap either, with a cost of 0.73 0.73 pp for sharing the keys and 2.94 2.94 pp for sharing the keys and values (Appendix A.3 ). We thus keep a separate cache per recurrence in our best-performing setting, and note that the cache size can be traded against accuracy at inference without retraining. Table 8 in the appendix reports sharing applied during training.

我们看到,随着预算的缩减,成本增加。 N = 3 n{=}3 的缓存缩写为 1.45 ×\时,成本为 0.75 0.75 pp,N = 1 n{=}1 的缓存缩写为 0.727 ×\时,低于基数本身,成本为 5.43 5.43 pp. 这可以归因于重现步骤的密钥和值是从该步骤的状态计算出来的,因此一个重现步骤读取另一个步骤的缓存会处理不符合其自身输入的表示. 使用共享激活器对模型进行培训,也没有弥补这一差距,共享密钥的费用为0.73 0.73pp,共享密钥和值的费用为2.94 2.94pp(附录A.3)。 因此,我们每一次重现时都会单独保留一个缓存,在最佳的环境下,并且注意到缓存大小可以在不进行再培训的情况下与准确性进行交易。 附录中的表8介绍了培训期间的使用情况。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced the first prune-then-loop retrofit of a pretrained VLM evaluated on VQA. The retrofitted model outperforms the unpruned baseline while storing 23.3% fewer language-model parameters, with the gains concentrated on reasoning-oriented benchmarks. This gain is due to the recurrence itself, as the loop accounts for a significant improvement over the pruned single-pass baseline. At the same time, the recovery requires the text-only training stage, which yields the best performance among all evaluated training strategies. Finally, retrofitting recurrence into a pretrained VLM outperforms adding a vision encoder to a pretrained recurrent language model, which makes the retrofit the best performing route to a recurrent VLM among all evaluated baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们引进了第一个在VQA上评估的经过预先训练的VLM的prune-when-loop改装. 改造后的模型在存储23.3%的语言模型参数的同时,超过了未铺设的基线,收益集中于以推理为导向的基准. 这一增益是由于复发本身,因为循环比铺设的单通道基线大有改进。 与此同时,恢复工作需要只有文本的培训阶段,这在所有经评价的培训战略中产生最佳业绩。 最后,将重现改造为预先训练的VLM超标,将视觉编码器添加到预先训练的经常性语言模型中,这使得改造成为所有被评价基线中最优表现的VLM经常性通道.
